prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Select Companion Personality & Appearance", "Choose your pet's core daily behavior style on the left and visual look on the right.", "Personality & Style Options"]
1: ["Your Desktop Companion is Live", "Your pet is now active on your desktop screen. Review key controls below to manage your pet anytime.", "Left click: Interact | Right click: Pet Menu | Drag: Position on Desktop"]
2: []
3: ["Recommended Companion Modes For You", "Based on your preferences, choose how your pet will assist your daily routine."]
4: ["How Should Your Companion Join Your Daily Routine?", "Select whether you prefer a calm focus partner for work, an active break reminder companion, or a casual desk buddy."]
5: ["Initializing Desktop Companion Engine", "We are loading your pet's animations, voice responses, and desktop behaviors.", "Setting up desktop environment..."]
6: ["Official Desktop Pet Adoption Certificate", "Your companion is officially registered and ready to join your desktop.", "Certified Desktop Companion"]
7: ["Meet Your Companion On Your Screen", "Your pet is now active on your desktop! Use the quick reference below to manage companion visibility and actions.", "Quick Tip: Click and drag your pet anywhere on your screen, or right-click to open options."]
8: ["Use bright lighting and clear subject framing for best pet generation accuracy.", "Well-lit photo | Single face visible | High contrast background"]
9: ["Sign In to Protect & Sync Your Pet", "Creating an account ensures your pet's memory, items, and companion stats stay safe across devices.", "Cloud Backup Active: Your companion state is automatically linked to your sign-in method."]

verdicts.problem: Requests personal information by asking for a photo featuring a face.
